title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by every core document schema. Not a document kind itself.

text.description: Required free text: non-empty and not whitespace-only.

slug.description: Lowercase slug, unique within its scope.

name.description: Snake-case key: metric keys, dimension names, artifact roles, error codes.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier or immutable revision (ids, digests, commit hashes). No whitespace.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest computed by the application: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset.

object_key.description: Object storage key: relative, slash-separated, no empty, '.' or '..' segments.

object_prefix.description: Object storage prefix: like an object key, ending with '/'.

interface_ref.description: Interface name and version, e.g. ranked-run/v1 or cr-evidence/v0.2.

quantity.description: Kubernetes-style resource quantity, as a string.

resource_map.description: Resource name to quantity, e.g. cpu, memory, nvidia.com/gpu.

dimensions.description: Dimension name to value for one measurement slice.

content_ref.description: Reference to an immutable stored record with its content digest.

pinned_ref.description: Immutable identity of a dataset, baseline or control.

producer_ref.description: A registered step manifest revision (a producer, or an experiment step of a workflow).

open_object.description: Project-defined content, checked against the pinned project schema.

json_schema.description: A project-supplied Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, checked against the metaschema at load.
